name: Membranes, Transport & Bioelectricity
summary: How membranes control what enters and leaves the cell, and how ion gradients create the voltages that nerves, muscles and hearts run on.

topics.name: Lipid bilayer physics: fluidity, rafts, asymmetry and curvature
Passive transport: channels and carrier proteins
Primary active transport: the Na+/K+ pump and ABC transporters
Secondary active transport: symporters and antiporters
Electrochemical gradients and the Nernst equation
Resting membrane potential and the Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz equation
Ion channel families: voltage-gated, ligand-gated and mechanosensitive
Membrane as an electrical circuit: capacitance, resistance and cable properties
Excitable cells: an introduction to the action potential
Epithelial transport and transcellular movement of water and solutes
